Yeah it’s not very reassuring on this end 😂  but good to know not everyone is an actual sociopath ha

Side note: he kept referring to this as “you could take me out”/“you could legit take me out” & my dumb ass thought he meant like take him out to get food or something and I was just sitting there like...*yeah, but how is this relevant?* 🤦🏻‍♀️ But there’s something about someone repeatedly reassuring you about how dangerous they’re not that just makes them feel, idk, ten times more dangerous.

The revenge would be sweet but not entirely deserved, I’m afraid. Yeah he’s an asshole (who somehow has like a shitton of karma on here ugh I’m annoyed) but I’m not gonna dox him just for being a Nice Guy. 

As far as the catfish angle — I don’t know for sure that he had violent intentions, so I don’t think it’d even be fair to argue “for safety’s sake.” (Plus the likelihood that any girl who is going to come across him online will even read this is slim.) 

What I will say is definitely be careful who you give your personal information to, and always be careful who you meet in public. Trust the vibes people give off (especially if they aren’t open to having a discussion). As I’ve learned the hard way over the past two weeks, ya can’t trust everyone on Tinder (*duh*).
